  "tokenized_directions": [
    {
      "step": 1,
      "text": "Dress the {{ing_01|hare}} (as usual), garnish (marinate) it, place in a square pan."
    },
    {
      "step": 2,
      "text": "In the mortar put {{ing_02|pepper}}, {{ing_03|lovage}}, {{ing_04|origany}}."
    },
    {
      "step": 3,
      "text": "Moisten with {{ing_05|broth}}, add {{ing_06|chicken livers}} (sauté), {{ing_07|cooked brains}}, {{ing_08|finely cut meat}}, {{ing_09|3 raw eggs}}, {{ing_05|broth}} to taste."
    },
    {
      "step": 4,
      "text": "Wrap it in {{ing_10|caul or parchment}}, fasten with skewers."
    },
    {
      "step": 5,
      "text": "Half roast on a slow fire."
    },
    {
      "step": 6,
      "text": "Meanwhile, put in the mortar {{ing_02|pepper}}, {{ing_03|lovage}}: crush and moisten with {{ing_05|broth}}, {{ing_11|wine}}, season, make it hot, when boiling bind with {{ing_12|roux}}."
    },
    {
      "step": 7,
      "text": "The half-done {{ing_01|hare}} immerse (finish its cooking in this broth), sprinkle with {{ing_02|pepper}} and serve."
    }
  ],
